reviews.author: SaraP
reviews.headline: Soft, comfortable, true-to-size, and versatile—a great everyday basic!
reviews.body: I’ve really been enjoying this A.N.A. long sleeve T-shirt! The fabric is soft, stretchy, and comfortable, and the fit is true to size and color with a flattering fitted look. The crew neckline is simple and comfortable, and I like the hemline because it gives me the option to wear the shirt tucked in or untucked with shorts or pants. It keeps me warm without feeling bulky, and after wearing it for a week, I haven’t noticed any pilling or shrinkage. Overall, it feels like a great-quality and versatile everyday basic.

reviews.author: BusinessCasual22
reviews.headline: Soft and Stretchy - DOES RUN SMALL
reviews.body: I needed some basic tops for layering this fall and these worked out great! As most have said, these run a bit small. I sized up to an XXL instead of an XL and was happy with the fit. These shirts are a nice mix of soft and stretchy and I would purchase them again.

reviews.author: MarissaC
reviews.headline: This top is one of my new favorite pieces! I got so many compliments on it!
reviews.body:
I recently got this long sleeve Anna shirt, and it has quickly become one of my new favorite pieces. The color is absolutely gorgeous it's a rich wine or cranberry shade that is perfect for the fall season and transitions so well into the holidays. Everyone thought the color was really beautiful, and I got so many compliments when I wore it!
​It is extremely comfortable, and the lightweight thinner fabric makes it super easy to style. It is such a versatile top that you can easily dress it up for a nice outing, wear it casually for something simple like a trip to the park, or layer it under a heavier coat when it gets really cold out.
​It fits perfectly, and taking care of it has been a breeze. I always wash my personal clothes in cool water and line dry them just to be safe, and it washes easily while maintaining its comfortable fit and vivid color, it jas not shrunk at all. Overall, it is a stunning, easy-care top that I find myself reaching for all the time!

reviews.headline: I've had 10 of these for 1+ years: I LOVE THEM!
reviews.body: I LOVE these tops and have more than 10 in different colors. The fabric is substantial, not the flimsy, almost see-through you find in other stores, and it is 100% cotton, not modal, tercel, or some other plastic junk. The durability is exceptional: I've many of these tops for over a year; I wear them daily to work and wash them after 1 wear so they see a lot of use; the fit, feel, and color are the same as when I bought them. Because the fabric is not flimsy or synthetic it doesn't cling to all the nooks and crannies, it hangs nicely and smoothly on the body. I am extremely happy with them and I am back here to see if there are new colors. The price is great for the quality and I want to stock up because I'm afraid that in the future they will also succumb to the enshitification of America and start skimping on quality.

reviews.headline: Easy to use stand mixer
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This mixer is a beautiful design and works really well for all intended purposes. It has a stainless steel bowl with a whisk, beater, and dough hook attachment as well as a removable shield for the bowl. I love that the top can tilt up so you can easily see in the bowl to scrape down the sides, etc. The size is a medium size so it doesn’t take up too much room on the countertop or in a cabinet but can still make a good amount. All of the removable pieces can be dishwashed which I love. I have used this to make cookies for a few times and it has worked great to knead dough.

reviews.headline: Sleek, functional, and versatile. Great mixer!
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Love love love this mixer! It has been such a great help for busy mornings with my toddler, summer potlucks, and midnight cravings. Easy to clean, beautiful on the counter, and a thorough manual with clear instructions make it a great everyday kitchen tool. It is not overly loud or disruptive, and stays put while mixing and vibrating. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: RosaO
reviews.headline: Impressive

reviews.author: ClaireD
reviews.headline: Excellent mixer
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This is an excellent home mixer. The mechanism for the bowl and attachments to click in works great and the mixer is very intuitive to use. I previously used a KitchenAid brand mixer and this is comparable while taking up less storage space. The mixer is also not too heavy but has a counter suction feature so that it stays stable.

reviews.author: RashikaS
reviews.headline: So easy to use
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This bowl feels spacious, and the mixer has a sturdy, sleek design that looks great on my kitchen counter. I love having multiple speed settings, and it’s easy to adjust the speed while mixing. The stainless steel bowl is a nice size for everyday baking, and the included attachments make it convenient for different recipes. It’s also fairly easy to use, even for someone who is new to stand mixers.Excited to try it for cakes and cookies

reviews.author: MarcusW
reviews.headline: Quick, effortless power
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I've never really owned a stand mixer and have only used one a few times, so I wasn't sure what to expect. I used it to shred my instant pot chicken and was delighted by the ease and efficiency. I normally shred it by hand with two forks, but the mixer made it effortless and had plenty of power.  The controls were simple, the bowl locked into place, and it was easy to use.  Overall, it's a straightforward, user-friendly mixer that handled the task without any fuss.

reviews.author: TayshaB
reviews.headline: High quality mixer
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This mixer is looks very sleek and high end and also works great which for me, I always look for both: functionality and how well it looks in my kitchen. Super easy to clean and store (I have limited storage so that is a plus!) and also, not too loud when in use. The attachments are very high quality as well and very functional. It’s also not too heavy in general so I can use it and put it away each time with ease. In general, a great high-quality mixer!

reviews.author: AmandaD
reviews.headline: My #1 cologne for date night
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Absolute standout scent and quite honestly my favorite. Also, the ladies. The scent is smooth, warm, and sophisticated with the perfect balance between sweetness and spice. I get a solid 8 hours of wear with a strong projection, yet not overwhelming—huge plus. Reach for this if you want a classy, seductive, and masculine scent.

reviews.author: IsaiahR
reviews.headline: Subtle but pleasant
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The Le Male Le Parfum has a very warm but masculine smell to me. Its projection isn’t that strong but when I have someone get close enough to smell it they always compliment me and ask what it is (if they aren’t able to guess it’s JPG). I would absolutely recommend this to anybody who wants a subtle but pleasant fragrance.

reviews.author: HieuT
reviews.headline: It help me a lot
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Finally I find a perfume that made me feel confident when I go outside. Since my job requires me to walk outside a lot in the hot sun made me sweat a lot. I always feel so embarrassed when I stand around people when I sweat a lot. This Perfume smell strong enough to help me cover the smell of my sweat. Even thought it strong but it also able to maintain it natural smell.

reviews.author: AliaskarU
reviews.headline: A grown-up take on a classic — warm, mature, and long lasting.
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Been trying JPG Le Male Le Parfum lately, and honestly? This is Le Male all grown up. The original is a classic, but this one has way more depth. It opens with warm vanilla and cardamom, then settles into a smoky, woody amber that really sticks around. It's sweet, but not in a young or cheap way it feels cozy and seductive at the same time. What I like most is the vibe. It's mature and confident, a bit mysterious too. Perfect for a date night, but it also gives off that "I've got my life together" energy. And the performance is great two sprays and it lasts the whole day. It's unique enough that people actually ask what you're wearing, but still familiar enough that it never feels like you're trying too hard. For me, it's one of the best modern sweet woody scents out there. Final verdict: 9/10, worth a blind buy.

reviews.author: JeamMathewA
reviews.headline: Great fragrance with excellent duration and strong sillage. The packaging looks premium, and the scent is smooth, memorable, and perfect for special occasions.
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This fragrance exceeded my expectations. The texture feels smooth and rich, making every spray enjoyable. The sillage is strong without being overwhelming, and I received several compliments while wearing it. Its warm, sweet, and spicy scent is highly memorable and stands out from many other men's fragrances. The packaging is elegant and luxurious, with the iconic bottle design looking amazing on display. The duration is excellent, lasting all day on my skin and even longer on my clothes. Overall, this is a high-quality fragrance that is perfect for evenings, special occasions, or whenever you want to leave a lasting impression.

reviews.author: CarlosT
reviews.headline: Smells very good
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This product smells so good, it last very good. The smells gives you a party vibe and it is strong. I totally recommend this product and it gives you a lot of compliments

reviews.author: DanielY
reviews.headline: refined, warm, and masculine fragrance that’s easy to recommend and worthy of a full bottle.
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This is one of my favorite designer fragrances. The scent opens with a smooth blend of cardamom before transitioning into warm vanilla, lavender, and rich woods, creating a classy, masculine fragrance that feels both elegant and inviting. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a versatile fragrance that works especially well for evenings, dates, and cooler weather. While it shares some DNA with the original Le Male line, it stands out with a deeper, creamier, and more refined character that feels unique enough to earn a place in any collection. The packaging is premium, and even though I received a sample, it reflected the brand’s attention to detail. The full-size bottle is one of the best-looking designer bottles available, featuring the iconic black-and-gold torso design that feels luxurious and instantly recognizable. Overall, it’s a fragrance I’d happily purchase in a full bottle.￼

reviews.author: AngelC
reviews.headline: Long lasting smell
reviews.body: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I’m still pretty new to fragrances, but I really liked this one. It smells clean, warm, and a little sweet without being overpowering. It lasted most of the day on me, and I got a couple of compliments while wearing it. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it’s a bit strong when you first spray it, but after a while it smells nice.

customer_service.title: Returns Policy
customer_service.body_html:
Our Common-Sense Returns Policy

If you're not completely satisfied with your purchase, return it with your receipt within 90 days of purchase for a full refund in the form of original payment. Refunds without a receipt will be issued as JCPenney gift card at the item's lowest selling price, plus applicable state tax.

Returns with a gift receipt receive a JCPenney gift card for the purchase price.

How to Return

  • In store: bring your item and receipt to any JCPenney register or customer service desk.
  • By mail: use the return label included with your order (return shipping fees are deducted from your refund).
  • Curbside: bring your return to any store offering curbside pickup and we'll process it from your car.

Exceptions

Fine jewelry, watches, and household electronics must be returned within 60 days with the original packaging. Gift cards are not returnable. Special-occasion dresses must retain their original tags.

customer_service.title: Shipping Information
customer_service.body_html:
Delivery Options

  • Standard Shipping: arrives in 3-5 business days. $8.95, or FREE on orders of $75 or more.
  • Express Shipping: arrives in 2 business days. $12.95.
  • Same Day Pickup: order by 3pm and pick up at your store today. Free.
  • Curbside Pickup: we'll bring your order out to your car. Free.

Shipping FAQs

Orders placed after 3pm local time begin processing the next business day. You'll receive an email with tracking as soon as your order ships. Most orders over $75 ship free; furniture and mattress deliveries are quoted at checkout.

customer_service.title: Rebates
customer_service.body_html:
Product Rebates

JCPenney and select manufacturers offer mail-in and online rebates on eligible products. To check a rebate status or submit a claim, have your order number and the product's model number ready.

Rebate processing typically takes 6-8 weeks after submission. Rebate amounts arrive as a prepaid card by mail.

customer_service.title: Synchrony Pay Later
customer_service.body_html:
Synchrony Pay Later

Introducing Synchrony Pay Later, a simple way to buy the Jewelry you love now and pay later in predictable monthly, equal payments over time. Available for fine jewelry purchases of $300 and up, with predictable monthly payments, no hidden fees, an instant decision, no payment required at time of purchase, and no ongoing commitment when paid in full.

How It Works

  • Shop at jcp.com for fine jewelry ($300+ after discounts).
  • Select Synchrony Pay Later as your payment method at Checkout.
  • If approved, pay over 6, 12, or 24 months depending upon eligibility.

Frequently Asked Questions

Will applying impact my credit score? Applying for a Synchrony Pay Later loan amount equal to or greater than $3,000 may impact your credit score.

Can I have multiple loans at the same time? Yes, you can have multiple Synchrony Pay Later and/or other Synchrony loans, subject to credit approval.

What if I don't see Synchrony Pay Later at Checkout? To see Synchrony Pay Later in checkout, you must have fine jewelry items in your cart ranging from $300 to $12,000 after discounts. If you have gift cards in your cart, your order won't be eligible (try removing the gift card or choosing another form of payment).

Can I use my loan to make additional purchases? No, the installment loan can only be used to finance the original purchase. You are welcome to apply for another Synchrony Pay Later loan at JCPenney.com.

Is Synchrony Pay Later different from a credit card? Yes. Synchrony Pay Later is an installment loan, so it can only be used to finance the purchase for which it was opened.

Where can I manage my account and make payments? Online at paylater.syf.com by ACH transfer, with auto payment available, or by phone at 844-373-4960. Payments cannot be made in-store or on JCPenney.com.

What if I need to make a return? We gladly accept most returns by mail and in stores within 60 days of purchase for free. Returned items must be in original, saleable condition with original tags. Shipping and delivery fees are non-refundable. See our Return Policy for more details.

Will I earn Rewards points? If you are already enrolled in JCPenney Rewards, you will earn points on purchases made with Synchrony Pay Later.

*Subject to credit approval. Synchrony Pay Later loans are provided by Synchrony Bank. Offer available for purchases starting at $300. Maximum credit approval of $12,000. Example: A 6 month term of a $500 purchase and a 0% rate requires monthly payments of $83.34. A 12 month term of a $1,000 purchase and a 19.99% rate requires monthly payments of $92.64. A 24 month term of a $3,000 purchase and a 29.99% rate requires monthly payments of $167.72.

customer_service.title: Same Day & Curbside Pickup
customer_service.body_html:
Fast + Free Same Day Pickup

Pick up your order at a store location near you! Place an order on JCP.com 2 hours prior to store closing to get your order today. Orders are typically ready within 2 hours. At checkout, select Free Same Day Pickup. You'll receive an email when your order is ready. If you can't make it that same day, we'll hold your purchase at the store for 10 days.

Both Curbside and In-Store Pickup are available during normal store hours. Follow the instructions from your "Ready for Pickup" email — and when you arrive, choose the pickup option best for you.

Curbside Pickup

To use Curbside Pickup at JCPenney:

  • Park: Proceed to the dedicated curbside parking area outside of the store.
  • Check in: Use the app or jcp.com to let us know you're there.
  • Drive away: Orders are placed in your trunk or backseat and then you're good to go!

In-Store Pickup

To use In-Store Pickup at JCPenney:

  • Head inside: Visit your store's in-store pickup location and an associate will be happy to help with your order.
  • Confirm the order: Show the associate your valid driver's license or ID, as well as the credit card used to pay for the order.
  • Enjoy: Once you've received your confirmed order from the associate, you're all set to enjoy your purchase!

Free Ship to Store for Orders Over $25

If your online purchase is not available for Same Day Pickup, you can have your order shipped directly to the store for free. Just choose Curbside or In-Store Pickup at checkout. When your order is ready for pickup, we'll send you an email to let you know. Most orders are ready within 4-7 business days.

If you'd rather have your order shipped to your home and delivered directly to you, a friend or a loved one, select Ship to Home at checkout.
